chapter.verse: Abraham’ hun lai-a kialpi ban-ah, tu-in gamsungah kialpi tung hi. Filistia mite’ kumpipa Abimelek omna Gerar-ah Isaak pai hi.
Ama' tungah Topa kilang a, “Izipt-ah paisuk kei in;kong gen ding leitangah teng in.

Hih leitang-ah tawl khat om in, nang tawh kong omkhawm ding a, thupha kong pia ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh nang leh na suan-le-khakte' tungah hih leitangte kong pia ding a, na pa Abraham’ tungah ka thuciam ka tungsak ding hi.

Na suan-le-khakte van-a aksi bangin tampi ka phasak ding a, na suan-le-khakte' tungah hih leitang khempeuh ka pia ding hi; na suan-le-khakte thupha ka piak bangin leitung minam khempeuh in thupha a ngah nadingun hong ngen ding uh hi:
Bang hang hiam cih leh Abraham in ka thu mangin, ka sawlna, ka thupiakna, ka ngeina kip leh ka thu zui hi,” ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Gerar-ah Isaak teng hi.

Tua mun a mite in ama' zi tawh kisai thu a dot uh ciangin amah in, “Ka sanggamnu hi,” ci hi; bang hang hiam cih leh, “Rebekah’ hangin tua mun mite in hong that kha ding ahih ciangin,” ci-in ngaihsun ahih manin, “Ka zi,” a cih ding lau hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amah ngaihbaang hi.
Tua lai-ah amah sau veipi a om khit ciangin, Filistia mite’ kumpipa Abimelek kongvangneu panin khuadak a, Isaak in a zi Rebekah a noh laitak mu kha hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Abimelek in Isaak samin, “En in, amah na zi hi; tua ahih ciangin bangci-in nang in, ‘Amah ka sanggamnu hi,’ ci thei na hi hiam? ci hi. Isaak in ama' kiangah, “Ama hangin si kha ding ka hih ciangin,’ ci-in ngaihsun ka hihna hang hi,” ci hi.
Abimelek in, “Ko’ tungah bang ci-a hih bang hong hih na hi hiam? Mite khatpeuh peuh na zi tawh lum khawm pak thei ding a, kote’ tungah mawhna hong tun’na hi ding hi,” ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Abimelek in mi khempeuh thu zasak a, “Hih mipa ahi zongin a zi ahi zongin a su-kha peuhmah kithat ding hi,” ci hi.
Isaak in tua leitangah khai tuh a, tua kum mahin a zah zakhat la hi. Topa in amah thupha pia a,
tua mipa a hau suakin, a hau mahmah a suah matengin ngah behbeh hi.
Amah in tuuhon leh bawnghon, innkuan mi tampi nei a, Filistia mite in amah eng uh hi.
(Ama' pa Abraham’ hun lai-a a pa’ nasemte in a tawh tuikhuk khempeuh tu-in Filistia mite in hucipin lei vuk uh hi.)
Abimelek in Isaak’ kiangah, “Kote’ kiang panin paikhia in; bang hang hiam cih leh kote sangin nang na vanglian zaw hi,” ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tua mun panin Isaak paikhia a, Gerar kuam sungah phual satin tua mun-ah teng hi.
Isaak in a pa Abraham’ hun lai-a a kitosa tuikhukte to kik hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Abraham’ sih khit ciangin Filistia mite in tuate vukcip uh hi; amah in a pa’ phuahsa minte mah phuak hi.
Ahih hangin Isaak’ nasemte in tua kuam sung to-in tuikhuk a muh uh ciangin,
Gerar gancingte leh Isaak’ gancingte kitawng uh a, “Tui, ko aa hi,” ci uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in tua tuikhuk Esek ci-in min phuak hi, bang hang hiam cih leh amaute leh amah kitawng uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in tuikhuk dang khat to uh a, tua tungtang-ah zong amaute kitawng uh hi; tua ahih ciangin amah in tua pen Sitnah ci-in min phuak hi.

Tua mun panin amah kiin-in tuikhuk dang khat to hi, tua tungtangah amaute kitawng lo uh hi; tua ahih ciangin amah in a min Rehboth ci-in phuak hi, “Bang hang hiam cih leh tu-in Topa in eite’ adingin omna hong bawlsak khin a, eite hih gamah i pung ding hi,” ci hi.
Tua lai mun panin amah Be-ersheba-ah paito hi.

Tua zan mahin ama' tungah Topa kilang a, “Keimah in na pa Abraham’ Pasian ka hi hi; lau kei in, bang hang hiam cih leh ka nasempa Abraham’ huhau-in nang tawh kong om a, nang leh na suan-le-khakte thupha hong pia-in kong pungsak ding hi,” ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah in tua lai mun-ah biakna tau khat lamin Topa ' tungah thungen a, tua munah a puanbuk lam hi. Tua lai-ah Isaak’ nasemte in tuikhuk khat to uh hi.
Tua ciangin Isaak' kiangah Gerar panin Abimelek, amah thu lamlakpa Ahuzzath leh a galkap mangpa Fikol tawh pai hi.
Isaak in amaute' kiangah, “Note in kei hong mudahin note' kiang panin hong hawlkhia na hih uh ciangin bang hangin kei' kiangah hong hawh na hi uh hiam?” ci hi.

Amaute in, “Nang tawh Topa a omna tel takin ka mu uh hi; tua ahih ciangin, kote in nang hong sukha loin, nang' tungah bangmah hong hih loin, a hoihin gamta-in lungnuam takin kong sawlkhiat mah bangun kote' tungah nang in siatna nong bawl loh nadingin nang leh kote' kikal-ah kiciamna khat om hen la,nang tawh thuciamna khat bawl ni, a ci hi ung. Nang in tu-in Topa ’ thupha piak na hi hi,” ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah in amaute’ adingin pawi khat bawl a, amaute in ne-in dawn uh hi.
Zingsangin amaute thobaih uh a, khat leh khat kiciamna bawl uh hi; Isaak in amaute a lampi ding uhah kha a, ama' kiang panin amaute lungnuam takin pai khia uh hi.
Tua ni mahin Isaak’ nasemte hong pai-in amau’ tawhsa tuikhuk thu ama' kiangah hong gen uh a, ama' kiangah, “Tui ka mu zo uh hi,” ci uh hi.
Amah in tua pen Shibah ci-in min phuak hi; tua ahih ciangin tua khuapi min pen tu ni dongin Be-ersheba kici hi.
Esau kum sawmli a phak ciangin, Hit mi Be-eri’ tanu Judith leh Hit mi Elon’ tanu Basemath zi-in la hi;
amaute in Isaak leh Rebekah’ nuntakna haksasak uh hi.
